info.title: Comit Matching Engine
info.description: Revision-safe candidate intake, dual vectors and contact-free ready pool.

get.description: Read collection/fit/activation progress for one owned vacancy.

post.description: Return to baseline and restart collection strictly after the reset timestamp.
Disable preference learning/application until an explicit reset re-enables it.
Retry a bounded failed sealed fit; rejected models require fresh reactions.

get.description: Read hypotheses and incomplete comparisons for one owned vacancy.

post.description: Pause new exploration, resume or discard old evidence with CAS and UUID replay.
Search the consented public pool with explicit bounded filters.

get.description: Read one current public profile without candidate contact access.
Report process liveness, independent of DB, token and model provisioning.
Check actual dependencies; unavailable model or migrations means HTTP 503.

put.description: Persist a monotonic upstream snapshot and queue artifacts when its checklist is complete.

get.description: Read progress or missing required inputs without returning contacts.

post.description: Restart bounded failed inference after fixing dependency availability.

get.description: Return coordinate indices and compatibility identity for combine consumers.

post.description: Append an authorized coordinate and durably migrate every previous candidate.

get.description: Return contact-free ready snapshots, never drafts or mixed strict generations.
Return the redacted Tinder PDF for a currently visible pool member.
Return the private PDF to trusted API, which must enforce candidate ownership.
Page only current eligible artifacts in the active strict generation.

put.description: Persist the canonical snapshot and original wire values, then queue eligible vacancies.

get.description: Read pipeline progress separately from business lifecycle status.
Read one completed preparation snapshot; absent readiness returns 404.

post.description: Explicitly restart a failed or backing-off current preparation job.
Immediately queue one exact snapshot; repeated caller keys preserve the original run.

get.description: Read durable run progress and report obsolete input generations.

post.description: Explicitly restart terminal failure with bounded attempts or refresh obsolete inputs.

get.description: Return a page from exactly one valid ready run, with no contact information.

put.description: Persist an internal Tinder exclusion handoff and invalidate the former batch.

get.description: Read pending, acknowledged, retrying and quarantined durable delivery totals.

post.description: Release one quarantined/retrying event for bounded durable delivery.
Queue one versioned top-k snapshot; optional caller keys persist across restart.

get.description: Read progress including explicit fallback and stale snapshot state.

post.description: Refresh current inputs or reset bounded terminal failures.

get.description: Return a page from a single valid run and disposition, preserving main explanations.

post.description: Like one explicit public candidate for an owned open vacancy without a ranked feed.

get.description: Read a manual like receipt before checking fresh candidate data.

post.description: Open a fresh 24-hour session for the owned vacancy.
Record one like or dislike and return a replay-safe receipt.

get.description: Read a prior receipt before a source freshness precheck.

post.description: Acknowledge client visibility separately from server delivery and explicit feedback.

get.description: Read this owner's prior acknowledgement before checking current source freshness.
Validate current source membership for action and redacted-PDF access.
Continue one immutable session with an opaque stable position cursor.
List saved candidates for this employer and vacancy.
List visited baselines and history badges for this vacancy.
Expose one owned saved membership as the post-selection handoff contract.

CandidateCard.title: CandidateCard
CandidateCard.description: Anonymous main shortlist card; position is provisional until the future reranker.

CandidateProfile.title: CandidateProfile
CandidateProfile.description: Complete or draft input; contacts remain private until downstream acceptance.

CandidateStatus.title: CandidateStatus
CandidateStatus.description: Pipeline state for one candidate without private input data or error details.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Deterministic specialization and grade with its upstream evidence status.

CombineRequest.title: CombineRequest
CombineRequest.description: Bounded main shortlist size; optional caller key prevents duplicate manual submissions.

CombineStatus.title: CombineStatus
CombineStatus.description: Exact vacancy, registry, pool and scoring-policy generations of one durable run.

Consent.title: Consent
Consent.description: Explicit, versioned consent snapshot supplied by the trusted API.

Coordinate.title: Coordinate
Coordinate.description: An immutable index in the append-only strict vector registry.

CoordinateAddition.title: CoordinateAddition
CoordinateAddition.description: Authorized registry extension; old coordinates cannot be reordered.

CoordinateEvidence.title: CoordinateEvidence
CoordinateEvidence.description: Status and declared level, without arbitrary private provenance strings.

DeliveryRetryRequest.title: DeliveryRetryRequest
DeliveryRetryRequest.description: Explicitly retry a quarantined/backing-off local outbox event after repairing its cause.

DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus
DeliveryStatus.description: Persisted acknowledgement counts for the two outbox streams and combine queue.

FeedCard.title: FeedCard
FeedCard.description: A served exposure with immutable source identity and feedback metadata.

FeedDecision.title: FeedDecision
FeedDecision.description: Durable action receipt; replay returns the same receipt without reapplying it.

FeedDecisionRequest.title: FeedDecisionRequest
FeedDecisionRequest.description: One explicit action bound to a served exposure and caller idempotency key.

FeedImpression.title: FeedImpression
FeedImpression.description: Owner-scoped first visible-impression receipt, without candidate feature payloads.

FeedImpressionRequest.title: FeedImpressionRequest
FeedImpressionRequest.description: Client acknowledgement of a visible card; delivery alone does not prove a view.

FeedPage.title: FeedPage
FeedPage.description: Stable position-cursor page from one 24-hour immutable session.

FeedRequest.title: FeedRequest
FeedRequest.description: Open one immutable feed session for a vacancy owned by the caller.

GradeResult.title: GradeResult
GradeResult.description:
Upstream grade result, allowing a declared grade until testing confirms it.

A real test session and approval timestamp are mandatory for an approved result.
Self-reported grades deliberately keep both fields optional: the API must never
manufacture a test session identifier for a candidate who has not tested yet.

HypothesisStatus.title: HypothesisStatus
HypothesisStatus.description: Collection and bounded search state, excluding IDs, facts and feature payloads.

HypothesisSummary.title: HypothesisSummary
HypothesisSummary.description: A fixed twenty-decisive-pair batch; diagnostics remain local and uncalibrated.

MatchedFeature.title: MatchedFeature
MatchedFeature.description: One explicit target and candidate evidence, with its computed strict contribution.

NarrativeClaim.title: NarrativeClaim
NarrativeClaim.description: Project, experience or achievement text plus the upstream evidence state.

NarrativeFacts.title: NarrativeFacts
NarrativeFacts.description: Optional structured facts; absence means unknown, never inferred from prose.

NarrativeReference.title: NarrativeReference
NarrativeReference.description: Explicit domain/stack reference, independently verified; provenance stays private.

NarrativeValue_Annotated_int__FieldInfo_.title: NarrativeValue[Annotated[int, FieldInfo(annotation=NoneType, required=True, metadata=[Strict(strict=True), Ge(ge=0), Le(le=1200)])]]

PoolEntry.title: PoolEntry
PoolEntry.description: Contact-free combine snapshot; published only with both vectors and a PDF.

PoolPage.title: PoolPage
PoolPage.description: Bounded pool page; ranks are global within each direction.

PreferenceCommand.title: PreferenceCommand
PreferenceCommand.description: CAS mutation with an owner-scoped replay key; retries never bypass the quality gate.

PreferenceStatus.title: PreferenceStatus
PreferenceStatus.description: Operational state without coefficients, personal feature payloads or participant identifiers.

PublicCandidateCard.title: PublicCandidateCard
PublicCandidateCard.description: Public identity-free card with global class rank and protected PDF URL.

PublicCandidateDetail.title: PublicCandidateDetail
PublicCandidateDetail.description: Current published revision and its safe allowlisted profile.

PublicFacts.title: PublicFacts
PublicFacts.description: Allowlisted narrative facts; arbitrary evidence never crosses this boundary.

PublicNarrative.title: PublicNarrative
PublicNarrative.description: Sanitized public text and typed facts only.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Versioned, stable public projection without identity or contact fields.

PublicReference.title: PublicReference
PublicReference.description: Typed narrative coordinate without private provenance.

PublicScalar.title: PublicScalar
PublicScalar.description: One published typed scalar with its independently supplied status.

PublicSkill.title: PublicSkill
PublicSkill.description: Published skill declaration with no evidence or provenance strings.

RerankCard.title: RerankCard
RerankCard.description: Original main factors remain visible alongside versioned R0 contributions.

RerankPage.title: RerankPage
RerankPage.description: One separate recommended/reserve page; candidates outside main top-k are absent.

RerankRequest.title: RerankRequest
RerankRequest.description: Optional caller identity persists across retries without duplicating a run.

RerankStatus.title: RerankStatus
RerankStatus.description: Exact immutable main/model identities; obsolete results are never served.

SalaryRange.title: SalaryRange
SalaryRange.description: Inclusive salary bounds in RUB; zero is allowed for unpaid internships.

SavedCard.title: SavedCard
SavedCard.description: An employer-scoped saved candidate projection with its source revision.

ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown
ScoreBreakdown.description:
Available-channel weights and reproducible score with raw rating provenance.

``rating_score`` is the raw class percentile. ``rating_contribution`` applies
the grade-status confidence from the immutable policy snapshot, so a declared
grade cannot look like a tested grade while remaining eligible for the pool.

SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters
SearchFilters.description: Explicit public-profile filters; salary overlap includes both endpoints.

SearchPage.title: SearchPage
SearchPage.description: Bounded search result with explicit degradation and freshness-aware pagination.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: Bounded independent employer query with an opaque continuation cursor.

SelectionPage.title: SelectionPage
SelectionPage.description: Only current, live main cards; stale pool/vacancy/schema generations cannot be served.

SelectionState.title: SelectionState
SelectionState.description: Persisted exclusion state, independent of disposable shortlist generations.

SelectionStateInput.title: SelectionStateInput
SelectionStateInput.description: Trusted handoff cannot manually release visited; feed policy owns structural release.

ShowcaseLikeConflict.title: ShowcaseLikeConflict
ShowcaseLikeConflict.description: A hard conflict string or an overrideable structured suitability warning.

ShowcaseLikeReceipt.title: ShowcaseLikeReceipt
ShowcaseLikeReceipt.description: Like receipt records the exact public revision selected outside the ranked feed.

ShowcaseLikeRequest.title: ShowcaseLikeRequest
ShowcaseLikeRequest.description: Manual like binds the explicitly viewed candidate revision to one vacancy.

ShowcaseMismatchWarning.title: ShowcaseMismatchWarning
ShowcaseMismatchWarning.description: Modal-ready confirmation bound to current candidate and vacancy revisions.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A registry key and ordinal level, retaining confirmation and provenance.

SkillFilter.title: SkillFilter
SkillFilter.description: Require one coordinate, a minimum declared level and allowed evidence states.

SkillGroups.title: SkillGroups
SkillGroups.description: Conjunctive coordinate requirements within each independent registry group.

StrictSchema.title: StrictSchema
StrictSchema.description: Version and hash identify both ordering and normalization of coordinates.

VacancyInput.title: VacancyInput
VacancyInput.description: Canonical trusted snapshot; incomplete drafts persist without invented requirements.

VacancyPipelineStatus.title: VacancyPipelineStatus
VacancyPipelineStatus.description: Business status and artifact state are independent, revision-safe dimensions.

VacancyReady.title: VacancyReady
VacancyReady.description: Complete selection input; omitted coordinates remain distinct from explicit zero.

VacancyReadyPage.title: VacancyReadyPage
VacancyReadyPage.description: Bounded page containing only current, active-schema, ready vacancies.

VisitedCard.title: VisitedCard
VisitedCard.description: An employer-scoped visited baseline retaining history across re-impressions.
